title: Dynamic molecular mechanism of the nuclear pore complex permeability barrier
authors: Kozai T; Fernandez-Martinez J; van Eeuwen T; Gallardo P; Kapinos LE; Mazur A; Zhang W; Tempkin J; Panatala R; Delgado-Izquierdo M; Raveh B; Sali A; Chait BT; Veenhoff LM; Rout MP; Lim RYH
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过活细胞纳米尺度观测揭示核孔复合体中FG重复无序蛋白域形成动态聚合物刷而非相分离凝聚体作为通透性屏障的机制，直接涉及IDR动态互作与屏障门控机制建模，对无序蛋白介导的PPI机制研究具有高度启发性。
abstract: Nuclear pore complexes (NPCs) mediate nucleocytoplasmic transport of specific macromolecules while impeding the exchange of unsolicited material. However, key aspects of this gating mechanism remain controversial. To address this issue, we determined the nanoscopic behavior of the permeability barrier directly within yeast S. cerevisiae NPCs at transport-relevant timescales. We show that the large intrinsically disordered domains of phenylalanine-glycine repeat nucleoporins (FG Nups) exhibit highly dynamic fluctuations to create transient voids in the permeability barrier that continuously shape-shift and reseal, resembling a radial polymer brush. Together with cargo-carrying transport factors the FG domains form a feature called the central plug, which is also highly dynamic. Remarkably, NPC mutants with longer FG domains show interweaving meshwork-like behavior that attenuates nucleocytoplasmic transport in vivo . Importantly, the bona fide nanoscale NPC behaviors and morphologies are not recapitulated by in vitro FG domain hydrogels. NPCs also exclude self-assembling FG domain condensates in vivo , thereby indicating that the permeability barrier is not generated by a self-assembling phase condensate, but rather is largely a polymer brush, organized by the NPC scaffold, whose dynamic gating selectivity is strongly enhanced by the presence of transport factors.
abstract_zh: 核孔复合体（NPCs）介导特定大分子的核质转运，同时阻碍非必要物质的交换。然而，这一门控机制的关键方面仍存在争议。为解决此问题，我们直接在酵母S. cerevisiae NPCs中，于转运相关时间尺度上测定了通透性屏障的纳米级行为。我们表明，苯丙氨酸-甘氨酸重复核孔蛋白（FG Nups）的大型内在无序结构域表现出高度动态的波动，在通透性屏障中形成瞬时空隙，这些空隙持续变形并重新封闭，类似于径向聚合物刷。与携带货物的转运因子一起，FG结构域形成一种称为中央栓的特征结构，该结构同样高度动态。值得注意的是，具有较长FG结构域的NPC突变体表现出交织网状行为，这减弱了体内核质转运。重要的是，真实的纳米级NPC行为和形态并未在体外FG结构域水凝胶中得到重现。NPCs在体内还排除自组装FG结构域凝聚体，从而表明通透性屏障并非由自组装相凝聚体产生，而主要是由NPC支架组织的聚合物刷，其动态门控选择性因转运因子的存在而显著增强。
